'''Maverse Pontilo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] businessman from [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] who supported the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the manager and founder of [[Pontilo Foundation]].

==Biography==
Living on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], Maverse and his family lived peacefully until the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] invaded their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. As a pragmatic man, Pontilo gave immediate support to the Imperial occupation forces. He then was sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], but his family were accidentally killed by [[Lancer Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Lancer Squadron]] instead of him. After this personal tragedy, he traveled to the [[Lower Markaran Outpost|Markaran Imperial Outpost]] to seek sanctuary.<ref name="OTT" />

In [[3643 BBY]], he tasked an Imperial spacer to help him find the Republic squad responsible for the death of his family, and retrieve their ID tags.<ref name="OTT" />
